content: Black Friday is entering the evening, which means one of the best times of the year to save some cash on a new pair of AirPods or the latest Apple Watch is coming to a close. After all, the holiday savings can help offset the unfortunate price hikes from earlier this year, when Apple raised the cost of some of its most popular gear. Some discounts still apply to recent releases like the Apple Watch Series 12 and touchscreen MacBook Pro, too, which are available at their lowest prices to date. In addition to a variety of discounts across retailers, Apple is offering up to $300 in gift cards with select purchases between November 27th and November 30th. How much you get back is determined by how much you spend, with up to $100 available for some iPhone and Apple Watch purchases, and up to $300 for the 16-inch MacBook Pro. That said, in some cases you may be able to save more by buying from other retailers. Apple’s last-gen earbuds lack active noise cancellation, but they still deliver good, relatively bass-rich sound, even if they don’t quite match the newer AirPods 5. They also offer voice call quality on par with the latest AirPods Pro. Read our review. * The second-gen AirPods Max are down to $419 ($130 off) at Amazon and Best Buy, which is $19 shy of their best price to date (Target also has them for about $10 more). Like the original, Apple’s latest over-ear headphones feature a luxurious build consisting of aluminum, steel, and a mesh fabric, but they offer better sound and noise cancellation. The new H2 chip also enables features like adaptive audio and live translation. Read our review. The headphones are a noticeable improvement over their predecessor, delivering more detailed sound and support for lossless audio. They also last up to 50 hours on a single charge, while their memory foam ear cushions make them comfortable enough for long listening sessions. Read our review. * The Beats Studio Buds Plus are down to around $89.95 ($80 off) at Amazon, Best Buy, and Target, nearly matching their lowest price to date. The wireless earbuds feature a slick, eye-catching transparent option and solid noise cancellation, especially at this price. They’re also exceptionally comfortable, with four ear tip sizes to help you find a secure fit. Sure, you don’t get wireless charging, but they offer IPX4 water resistance and up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge. Read our review. The redesigned laptop is Apple’s first with an OLED touchscreen, which allows for rich colors and deep blacks. It’s also noticeably thinner and lighter than the non-touchscreen 16-inch MacBook Pro, and features a new Dynamic Island that replaces the notch and provides quick access to controls and notifications.
